<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>

    <authors>iyulab</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>

    <releaseNotes>See CHANGELOG.md for release notes</releaseNotes>
    <copyright>Copyright (c) 2025 iyulab</copyright>
    <tags>ai agents multi-agent orchestration ironhive multi-provider dependency-injection</tags>

    <dependencies>

        <dependency id="IronHive.Abstractions" version="0.24.1" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />

        <dependency id="Polly" version="8.6.6" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
